summary_en: For an online purchase, the manual allows a return request within 7 calendar days after actual receipt, with original packaging, no signs of use, all accessories and manuals. Refunds use the original payment method within 10 business days; the store pays return shipping for regret. Preference exchanges: 7 days, perfect condition, original packaging, subject to availability. Manufacturing-defect exchanges: 30 calendar days after purchase, then manufacturer warranty assistance. Customized items, explicitly final-sale clearance items and wind mouthpieces are excluded in the manual. Eligibility depends on the actual receipt date, purchase channel and item condition. An estimated delivery date does not establish receipt. The team must review exceptions and any questions about statutory rights.

summary_en: PIX has a 5% list-price discount, which cannot be combined with promotional prices. Debit cards and boleto are accepted; boleto clearing takes up to 3 business days. The payment table says credit up to 12 interest-free installments with a BRL 100 minimum, while section 3.1 says up to 3 installments with a BRL 50 exception, 4-6 installments with BRL 80 minimum and 7-12 with BRL 100 minimum. summary_en: For metropolitan Campo Grande, the manual states free shipping for orders above BRL 500, a BRL 35 fee below BRL 500 and 1-3 business days. Other cities: PAC 5-12 business days, SEDEX 2-5, Jadlog 3-8; freight depends on postal code, weight and dimensions and cannot be quoted by this prototype. Large instruments may require a special quote. Tracking is sent after dispatch. These are policy estimates, not a live carrier promise. Do not validate or fabricate a tracking code from its format.

summary_en: Consult the promotion CSV active flag before quoting a discount. Campaign descriptions and seasonal dates do not establish an active offer. Promotions are not cumulative; the 5% PIX discount cannot be added to a promotional price. Present the original price, active discount percentage and resulting price together. Offers depend on available stock. Do not promise expired promotions or a price reservation for sold-out items.

summary_en: Emporio da Musica sells musical instruments only, not accessories such as strings, picks, cables, cases, pedals or amplifiers. Politely redirect accessory or unrelated requests; do not invent partner stores. Use a warm, informal but professional tone. The manual asks staff to forward complaints and respond within 24 business hours; this prototype cannot create a ticket or contact staff, so invite the customer to speak with the team without claiming an escalation occurred.

title: Warranty

summary_en: The fictional store manual states a 90-day manufacturing-defect warranty from receipt. Manufacturer warranties may vary from 6 months to 2 years; confirm the product certificate. Natural wear, misuse, falls, extreme climate, unauthorized modifications and purely cosmetic damage are excluded by the manual. Do not infer a product-specific term or make legal determinations.

summary_en: The manual limits personal-data use to order processing, delivery and status communications, consented marketing and legal/fiscal obligations. It says customers can request deletion through the team. This prototype does not process deletion requests, collect customer contacts, persist chats or claim LGPD certification. Do not expose other customers' orders.
